points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions formal docs/versions in citations, but not the rule for every claim or unversioned sources

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions same conditions and exact options, but omits no unit conversion and no inferred option compatibility

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: covered
points.why: requires warranted specs and rejects typical/marketing values for comparison

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: covered
points.why: explicitly says FSW data without tolerance limits is non-binding and may change

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: partial
points.why: requires competitor datasheets, but omits single R&S-internal-source caveat and third-party evidence

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: partial
points.why: warns against marketing values, but does not identify only platform/first validated/leadership/lower TCO language

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: partial
points.why: asks for competitor datasheets/options/conditions, but omits missing doc version, order number, release status, etc.

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: partial
points.why: says current satellite/use-case evidence is not a competitor comparison, but misses sales-mapping-not-test-configuration rule and required follow-up evidence types

invented: Keysight is described as having strong market presence in aerospace / defense
DO-160 is cited in a military / aviation drone EMC proposal context
A Starlink UT test-flow source maps spectrum analyzer choices to R&S FSW and Keysight N9040B UXA, and signal generator choices to R&S SMW200A and Keysight E8257D PSG
Satellite payload group delay measurement can use R&S FSW spectrum analyzer and R&S SMW200A signal generator
TVAC satellite payload testing passages state that setup drift, cable changes, and temperature changes require recalibration
